limitations: Representative grid-point context selected for a district anchor, not district/farm averages. Different districts may share a grid point. Crop suitability and live vulnerability are not computed.
method: Annual precipitation = sum of complete monthly totals; annual temperature = day-weighted monthly mean. Compare mean annual values of equal 10-year periods 2001–2010 and 2016–2025. Missing years prevent period comparison. Descriptive differences, not attribution, significance or forecasts.
